annotations.title: Each rail on each network, over 30 days

description: WHICH NETWORKS EACH AGENT PAYMENT AND WORK RAIL RUNS ON, WITH ITS LAST 30 DAYS: x402, Olas Mech, Virtuals ACP, Masumi, Tempo MPP and the ERC-8004 registries, one cell per rail and network with events in the rail’s own unit (x402 stablecoin transfers, paid requests, jobs, escrows, channels, registrations), dollars and distinct parties. An x402 event is a stablecoin transfer counted on x402 rails, catalogue candidates included: QUOTE `evidenceTiers` (confirmed_protocol, inferred_facilitator, candidate_catalogue, unknown) before the total, and never call it agent activity. THREE STATES: `read` (traffic in the window), `quiet` (read, a measured zero) and `not_read` (we know the rail runs there, from a deployment we checked or sellers listing it in the x402 catalogue, and do not read it: figures null with `why`, never 0). Units are never added across rails; dollars appear only on rails that settle in a priced token, null with the reason elsewhere. A network in no cell for a rail was not asked. `rail` and `chain` filter the cells; `rails`, `chains` and `coverage` describe the whole matrix. The stage ladder per rail (registered to repeated) is on /lifecycle; the lifetime counts per rail are agent_work_rails. Free.
